plan.title: RFQ auto title for product and location

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the default event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product as the single line item.
Select the requested delivery location, which is the final input for the generated title.
Verify that the product's variant was filled automatically.
Verify that the requested location was selected.
